BeeBlend Lychee Blossom Honey (also called litchi honey) is a raw, single-origin honey made by bees from the white blossoms of lychee orchards. It is light in colour with a fruity aroma you can smell as soon as you open the jar. What does lychee honey taste like? Delicately floral with notes of tropical fruit and a soft, rose-like sweetness that lingers. It is one of the most aromatic honeys in our range and a favourite with people who usually find honey too strong.
